app.name: MY Warranty
app.tagline: Know what you own. Know what's covered.

slide1.title: All your warranties. One place.
slide1.body: Add what you own once, and stop hunting through drawers for receipts.

slide2.title: Know what's covered.
slide2.body: See what your warranty includes, what it doesn't, and who to contact.

slide3.title: Never miss a warranty again.
slide3.body: We'll remind you before cover ends, while you can still do something about it.

slide4.title: Add your first product
slide4.body: It takes about thirty seconds. You can add more whenever you like.

auth.welcomeBody: Sign in to keep your products safe across devices.
auth.name: Your name
auth.resetBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: Check your email for the reset link.
auth.verifyEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish setting up your account.
auth.appleUnavailable: Sign in with Apple is only available on iOS.
auth.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
auth.acceptTerms: By continuing you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

home.noProductsYet: Add your first product to get started

empty.title: No products yet
empty.body: Your warranties will appear here once you add something.

emptyFiltered.title: No matches
emptyFiltered.body: Try a different search or clear your filters.

product.deleteBody: Its documents and history will be removed from your account.

add.title: Add a product
add.subtitle: Choose how you'd like to start
add.methodScanBody: We'll read the details from the receipt
add.methodPhotoBody: Snap the product and fill in the rest

form.futureDateWarning: That date is in the future. Save it anyway?

scan.guide: Place the receipt inside the frame
scan.processingBody: This usually takes a few seconds
scan.reviewBody: Have a quick look before we save it — we're not always right.
scan.noResultsBody: You can enter the details yourself instead.
scan.permissionBody: MY Warranty needs the camera to scan your receipt. Nothing is uploaded until you choose to save it.

detect.warrantyLikely: We found a likely warranty of {{months}} months. Please check it's right.

coverage.title: Coverage check
coverage.describeBody: Describe the problem in your own words.
coverage.describePlaceholder: e.g. My washing machine makes a loud noise during the spin cycle
coverage.disclaimer: Coverage assessments are based on available warranty documentation and do not constitute a guarantee that a manufacturer or service provider will approve a claim.
coverage.unavailableNoData: We don't have warranty documentation for this product yet, so we can't assess coverage. You can still contact the service provider.
coverage.failed: We couldn't complete the check. Please try again.

empty.title: Nothing needs you right now
empty.body: We'll let you know before any warranty runs out.

warrantyExpiring.title: {{name}} warranty ends soon
warrantyExpiring.body_one: Cover ends in {{count}} day. If you've noticed an issue, now may be the time to check coverage.
warrantyExpiring.body_other: Cover ends in {{count}} days. If you've noticed an issue, now may be the time to check coverage.

warrantyExpired.title: {{name}} warranty has ended
warrantyExpired.body: Cover ended on {{date}}. Your records stay here for reference.

paywall.title: Get more from MY Warranty
paywall.limitReachedBody: Upgrade to keep adding products. Everything you've already saved stays exactly where it is.
paywall.aiCoverage: Coverage checks are part of Plus
paywall.smartScan: Receipt scanning is part of Plus
paywall.freeFeatures: Up to 3 products · Manual entry · Receipt storage · Expiry reminders
paywall.plusFeatures: Up to 20 products · Coverage checks · Receipt scanning · Automatic warranty detection · Service provider lookup
paywall.proFeatures: Unlimited products · Priority coverage checks · Full warranty archive · Advanced claim help
paywall.renewalNote: Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your account settings.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.gracePeriod: We couldn't process your payment. Your plan stays active while the store retries.
subscription.downgradeNote: You have {{count}} products. On Free you can view and edit them all, but you won't be able to add more until you upgrade.

profile.title: Profile
profile.exportDataBody: Download your products, warranties and documents.
profile.restartForRtl: Restart the app to finish switching language.

notificationSettings.title: Notifications
notificationSettings.timeOfDayBody: We'll send reminders at this time in your local timezone.
notificationSettings.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off in your device settings.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.warning: This removes your products, documents, warranty records and claim history. It cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.keepsNote: Any active subscription must be cancelled separately in the App Store or Google Play.

documents.title: Documents
documents.duplicateBody: This looks identical to a document already on {{name}}. Add it anyway?
documents.sizeLimit: Files can be up to 25 MB.

sync.offlineBody: You can browse what's already here. New products will sync when you're back.
